text.title: Wardstone Rupture
text.body: A primeval elemental wardstone has cracked open, spewing wild astral discharge across the canyon floor. Eliminate the cultist cabal attempting to harness the rift and restore order.
text.obj.0: Destroy the west and east ward guardian packs
text.obj.1: Break the high ward guardians on the north ridge
text.msg.1: Earth golems shrug off blades—focus mages and archers on them while warriors screen.
text.msg.2: The western wardstone cracks! A healing scroll lay tucked beneath the plinth.
text.msg.4: The high wardstone shatters and the storm winds drop at once! Chronicler Zahra copies the quartz wardstones' harmonic frequencies into her ledger—notes she swears will save the coastal wards later.
text.win: All three ward guardian packs are destroyed and the highland veil lifts.
text.fail.1: Your hero has fallen beneath the wardstones.
